chapter: Porgy and Bess and Varsity Show
title: Nazarro's telegram and Bubbles' wish to escape to Australia
summary: Nazarro wires that he has a picture, but Bubbles had wanted to leave for Australia to get even for Canada, Pathe and the all-night filming; he missed the boat.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Mr. Bubbles, you were about to continue and talk about Nat Nazarro's letter that you received while you were in England, can you start back at that point and tell me a little bit about that?

At the finish of our engagement with Transatlantic Rhythm, Nazarro had gone back to America and sent us a telegram saying come to America on the next boat, have picture date for you. Which he knew I was crazy to go in pictures. So I sent him back I was coming.
Did you have to cut the show short?
No, the show was over. The show had closed. I'm just waiting to pick a chance to go to Australia before I get the telegram from Nazarro to come to New York, come to America.
Go to work. I just wanted to get away from the United States for a while. Get into another field. Do you understand me?
Why did you feel the necessity to do that?

From the past performances of Nazarro's actions. From the billing in Canada, from the two checks at Pathe' studio, from the all night working on the films overnight in Culver City, from other little things that he'd done in the past. I'm just now going to get even by leaving. And I found out that he sends this telegram to come back to America. But I learned also that the boat that's going to take me to Australia has already gone, the show has already been booked that they're going to send to Australia. So I was too late for that booking. So I was going to wait for the next one, but since I got this telegram, after learning that the show had already been
booked to Australia, I got this telegram from Nazarro and I let him know we'd be coming, so we caught the next boat and went to America.
